purpose: Resolve high-overlap HUNT rails by separating product family from subtype before canonical shelf placement.
rules: Current HUNT rail is never positive evidence.
A product feature or use case cannot override the product's primary family.
Exact supplier taxonomy outranks generic audience or contextual words.
SAFE_MOVE_CANDIDATE is shadow-only and never mutates Production.
Broad supplier categories require subtype evidence.
Out-of-scope or risky items are held out of canonical shelf rebuild.
Shelf density cannot override placement truth.
